topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Today, I found a delightful bouquet of sunflowers and roses waiting for me when I arrived home. No card, just an anonymous act of kindness or, perhaps, admiration. The arrangement was perfect, each stem precisely placed, a testament to care and thoughtfulness. I can’t help but admire the silent gesture, a pleasant mystery that sparkles like a secret. I set them in the best vase I have, right in the center of the living room, where their vibrant colors can shine and spread a bit of joy to everyone who enters. Whoever sent them has a keen eye for beauty and a heart for subtle surprises.
